== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Lothal (Dark) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), Virtual Set 19, PC-E1: the card image as the PC published it (a PNG file served under a .gif name) on 12 December 2022, taken unchanged from the PC's card-image repository ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/large/lothal.gif holotable commit 12d0bca], file <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/large/lothal.gif</code>). Not a recreation.
